system.description:
Taking the teachings of the Yamada to its extreme, you enter a brief striking stance, before releasing enough force that with a single strike, all creatures standing before you becomes a victim to your assault.

All creatures within range, must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Weapons Damage] + 2d8 and gain a rank of Shaken on a failure or half as much damage on a success.

Ideal Cut: This jutsu gains the effect of your Empty Blade attack, as if you were foregoing 2 attacks, but only against one of the affected creatures. If both d6’s trigger the Empty Blade effect, the affected creature becomes Severed.

Tao: This jutsu’s range becomes Self (20-foot radius) and doesn’t affect allied creatures.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8.
